name: The traveling dove
title: A blessing, 2 Corinthians 13:14
note: Sunday dove posted; system Pillow was broken, reinstalled via pip --ignore-installed
caption:
Follow the dove, then send this to someone you love.
This old blessing holds all of it together: the grace of Jesus, the love of the Father, and the nearness of the Spirit, for every one of us. It is a beautiful thing to speak over the people you are carrying in prayer this week.
2 Corinthians 13:14 (BSB)
Send this to someone who needs it today.
